text.p: Capital Intelligence, the specialist bank rating agency, has upgraded the long- and short-term ratings of Bahrain-based Investcorp Bank EC to A-/A-1 from BBB+/A-2.
A stable outlook has been assigned, Capital Intelligence said on Friday.
Established in 1982, Investcorp Bank operates under an investment bank licence issued by the Bahrain Monetary Agency.

Since its inception, it has had a successful track record of originating, structuring, placing and exiting profitably from large, sophisticated direct corporate investments, and to a lesser extent real estate transactions, Capital Intelligence said.

Investcorp has strengthened its financial position considerably in the past two years, and successfully concluded transactions have bolstered the liquidity profile of its balance sheet, said Capital Intelligence.
Its capital base has grown through retained earnings, and the bank continues to be very well cushioned against unforeseen, adverse market developments or potential losses from specific investments.
Investcorp's provisioning policy is very conservative, and full provisions are made for assets classified as underperforming.
Results for 1996 are expected to show improvement on last year's record performance.
